description: Estimate what a domain name is worth (the /domainvalue appraisal): an estimated market value in dollars with the signals behind it — comparable sales, marketplace listings, an appraisal model, SEO data. Use when the user asks what a domain is worth, whether one is a good buy, or to compare domain values. A fresh appraisal can take up to a minute; repeat lookups within 48 hours are cached and instant. Include the report_url in your reply so the user can open the full report.

domain.description: The domain to appraise, e.g. "startup.com". A full URL is accepted and reduced to the domain.
